subject.title: PDFs de admin con PII en stores públicos de Vercel Blob con pathnames predecibles

question: For these admin PII exports, is randomizing public Blob pathnames an acceptable fix for this issue, or must the exports move to private/authenticated reads before closure?
rationale: The source-confirmed bug is public predictable paths; the open PR fixes predictability but intentionally leaves public direct URL access, which is a security-boundary choice automation should not settle.

options.title: Land random suffix mitigation now
options.body: Repair and merge the linked PR as the immediate fix, then open or keep separate work for private authenticated reads if needed.

options.title: Require private authenticated reads
options.body: Hold the issue open until these admin exports use a private Blob store or authenticated proxy instead of public URLs.

options.title: Split mitigation and full hardening
options.body: Close this issue only after the randomization PR lands and create a narrower follow-up for direct-URL public access.

recommendation.title: Land random suffix mitigation now
recommendation.body: Repair and merge the linked PR as the immediate fix, then open or keep separate work for private authenticated reads if needed.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked PR discussion already routes review to alexcanHamelyn for touched-file expertise.
